entries.en:
Your badge is in the shape of a sunflower,{E108:0008} right,
Mr. E?
Does that have some kind of special meaning, or...?

It does.{E108:0010} Sunflowers follow the sun, correct?{E108:0010}
In other words,{E108:0008} they always face the light.

Just as we attorneys do.{E108:0010} We should always aim to be
on the side of liberty and justice.

Wow!{E108:0010} {E285}Then I'm going to work hard and be just like a
sunflower when I'm an attorney!
Heh.{E108:0010} I've no doubt that you will.
Is this your badge number here on the back?

That's right.{E108:0010} The number itself doesn't mean much, of
course.

Well, if it doesn't really matter,{E108:0008} then I want mine to be
a string of repeating digits!
(I'd...{E108:0018} {E285}actually pay to see that.)
Yes...{E108:0008} what a gorgeous design.

...Really?{E108:0010}
Just seems a bit out there to me.
Like,{E108:0008} how do you even get your tea in there?
Art isn't about function, Eddie --{E108:0008} it's about form.

Hmm...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}Guess I'll have to take your word for it, Mr. E.{E108:0010}
{E282}This art stuff is way beyond me!

Look!{E108:0010} There's something stamped on the bottom!{E108:0018}
It says...{E108:0008} {E284}"PH"...

I suppose that must be Paul Halique's pottery mark.{E108:0010}
Those are his initials, after all.
Ms. Bound said she is a big fan of his work.

His initials, huh?{E108:0010}
So if I'd made it,{E108:0008} {E285}it would say "EF"?

...Perhaps you should practice by initialing your
personal belongings first.
This lamp isn't working.
No.{E108:0010} Unfortunately,{E108:0008} it appears to be broken.
Would have been nice to see it all lit up just once.

Ms. Scone said it's good for relaxation, right?{E108:0010}
I could use some of that!
(Perhaps I'll get one for the office...)
*shudder*{E108:0010} There's so much blood...

I still can't believe it...{E108:0010}
A murder weapon stashed away in a candy castle...
You don't have to look, Eddie.{E108:0010} It's okay.

I...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I'm fine!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I mean,{E108:0008} if I'm going to be an attorney,{E108:0008}
{E280}I need to get used to this stuff, right?

Yes...{E108:0010} I suppose you do.{E108:0010}
(I look forward to seeing the man you become.)

So the lamps both have these hexagonal stands on the
bottom, right?

Yes.{E108:0010} I imagine the indentations in the pillars were
made to accomodate them.
And boy do they fit like a glove!

A roll of cloth of navy blue.{E108:0010}
It's a very calming hue.{E108:0010} I like it.

Yeah,{E108:0008} that was real deep and all, Mr. E!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}But let's get to the main event already and light it up!

A-{E108:0008}Alright.{E108:0010}
{E284}(But I wasn't trying to be deep or anything, though...?)
Whoa!{E108:0018} Look at all these buttons!
I believe they're for changing the color of the light.
Try pressing one, Eddie.
There.{E108:0010} Now the cloth is all lit up.
It's so pretty no matter how many times I see it...

The cloth is now glowing with a pale blue hue thanks
to the light-emitting device.

Didn't Ms. Scone say {E284}one of these cloths and its
machine are missing?
Who do you think could've taken them?

I have no idea.{E108:0010} But I suspect it might have something
to do with our case somehow.

This dark shade of blue...{E108:0010} Being around such a calming
color from time to time just might do me some good.

Jeez Louise, Milesarino!{E108:0010} {E282}Talk about corny!{E108:0018}
You could fill an entire extra-large bucket by yourself.
(That's rich coming from you, Fender...)

These must be the switches that change the color of
the cloth.
Let's see if they work...
Well...{E108:0010} the cloth has certainly changed color.
It's glowing with a pale blue hue.

And according to Detective Gumshoe,{E108:0008} {E285}this is what it
looked like when it was still draped over that statue.
...Indeed.
entries.ru: ...Именно.

entries.en: (But what does that have to do with the case...?)

This dark shade of blue...{E108:0010} Being around such a calming
color from time to time just might do me some good.

It's also just the right color for sneaking around in the
dead of night!

But I'd need something a lot brighter if I wanted to
make a big, splashy entrance...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Hmm...

...You can do both with this cloth through the power of
buttons, though?

Oh, yeah!{E108:0018}
In that case,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I'll take five!

This cloth went missing at the time of the IS-7
Incident...

...only to be found eighteen years later floating in the
Zodiac Hall fountain.

And there was another one that was all lit up and
draped around the Pisces statue, right?

(It seems these cloths may have a connection to both
cases,{E108:0008} past and present.)

Looks like this pedal lets you adjust the height of the
platform, Mr. Edgeworth!
Indeed.{E108:0010} Let's give it a try.
If you would, Kay.
On it!
entries.ru: Сейчас будет!

entries.en: ...Ta-da!

A single person could transport quite a heavy load
using one of these.
I'll say!{E108:0010} {E285}I bet I could even cart Gummy off with it!
(And for what purpose exactly, may I ask...!?)
The top of the platform is wet...

Maybe someone used it to move something liquidy
around?
(Yes,{E108:0008} but the question is who?{E108:0010} ...And what?)

To think this was disguised as a serving cart and used
to transport the body.

Don't forget the body was inside a hollow ice block.{E108:0010}
At least now we know why the platform was wet.
Boy did this thing get smashed up good, huh?

Indeed.{E108:0010} To the point where it's hard to make out what
it might have once been.

It'd be nice if it had some kind of distinguishing
feature or something...
Wait,{E108:0010} haven't we seen these letters before?

...This is the mark of the sculptor Paul Halique,
I believe.

But how did a chunk of ceramic end up in the middle
of a puddle of tea anyway?

(It's just a hunch,{E108:0008} but one suspect quickly comes to
mind...)
That is one swanky teapot!

That's one way of putting it.{E108:0010}
I lean more towards "eccentric", myself.

Whatever it is,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E280}it won't do for a Great Thief to remain
so ignorant about such chic things!
...{E108:0010}{E107:0002}Actually,{E108:0008} your ignorance is my bliss.
These letters say "PH",{E108:0008} right, Mr. Edgeworth?

Yes.{E108:0010} They show that the teapot was made by Paul
Halique.
They're his initials, obviously.
Right,{E108:0008} but...{E108:0010} I thought his real name was {E284}Artie Frost?

...It was.{E108:0010} Thereby making this a piece by the victim of
the IS-7 Incident as well.

(And his works seem to be everywhere here in Zodiac
Hall...)
The stand broke,{E108:0008} and the ship collapsed with it...

And the loud sound it made brought Ms. Bound
running.

Yeah...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Said the ship had already keeled over by the
time she got in here...
(Could that really have been the case...?)

All of Mr. Tangaroa's creations are missing a little
piece each.

Including one of the stands that was holding up the
ship.
Somebody really went all out.
Do you think it could've been the killer!?
...It's certainly a possibility.

Either way,{E108:0008} I think we can safely say the stand was
damaged in our mystery person's tampering spree.

(And when it broke,{E108:0008} the ship fell and smashed open
the treasure chest...)
(...which would have remained closed otherwise.)

The rock crystal stands and the pillars in front of the
castle feature the same hexagonal shape.

I believe the crystals are meant to be placed on top of
the pillars.
Oh, yeah!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Hexagon to hexagon!{E108:0010} Makes perfect sense!

(But if that's the case,{E108:0008} then why were they being
hidden inside the castle...?)

(The {E041}rolls of blue cloth{E042} and the {E041}rock crystals{E042} inside the
castle...)
entries.ru:
({E041}Рулоны синей ткани{E042} и {E041}кристаллы{E042} внутри
замка...)

entries.en: (I imagine both must belong to Ms. Scone.)
entries.ru:
(Наверное, и то и другое принадлежит
мисс Сдобиной.)

entries.en: Ms. Scone.
entries.ru: Мисс Сдобина.

entries.en: What were you using the items inside the castle for?
entries.ru: Для чего вам вещи, что лежат внутри замка?

entries.en: ...Let me guess...{E108:0010} Von Karma?
entries.ru: ...Дайте угадаю...{E108:0010} Фон Карма?

entries.en:
Eek!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}How did you know!?{E108:0018} P-Please don't ask me to tell
you!{E108:0010} He'll have my guts for garters!
entries.ru:
Ийк!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Откуда вы знаете!?{E108:0018} Н-Не заставляйте меня
рассказывать!{E108:0010} Он с меня три шкуры спустит!

entries.en:
(It seems the prosecution really has no intention of
sharing anything with the defense.)
entries.ru:
(Похоже, обвинение и впрямь не собирается
делиться с защитой ничем.)

entries.en:
Man...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Thought we were onto something with those
giant rock crystals, but...
entries.ru:
Эх...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Я-то думал, эти громадные кристаллы
что-то дадут, но...

entries.en:
!{E108:0018} ...What's that, dearie?{E108:0010} You're interested in my little
trinkets?
entries.ru:
!{E108:0018} ...Что-что, голубчик?{E108:0010} Тебя занимают мои
безделушки?

entries.en:
Yes, my sweet!{E108:0010} I use them to make people all lovely
and relaxed.
entries.ru:
Да, сладенький!{E108:0010} С ними людям делается славно
и спокойно.

entries.en: You use rock crystals and...{E108:0010} cloths to do that?
entries.ru: Вы делаете это кристаллами и...{E108:0010} тканью?

entries.en: I do,{E108:0010} I do!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It's wonderful,{E108:0008} you should see it!
entries.ru: Да,{E108:0010} да!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Это чудесно,{E108:0008} вам надо это увидеть!

entries.en:
And they're not just any old rock crystals, either --{E108:0010}
they're great big lumps of salt with lights inside them!
entries.ru:
И это не простые кристаллы —{E108:0010} это здоровенные
глыбы соли с лампочками внутри!

entries.en: Wow!{E108:0018} Those things are lamps?
entries.ru: Ух ты!{E108:0018} Так это лампы?

entries.en:
Teeheeheehee!{E108:0018}
Oh,{E108:0010} that's not even the half of it!
entries.ru:
Ти-хи-хи-хи!{E108:0018}
Ой,{E108:0010} это ещё даже не половина!

entries.en: Those cloths hold an even more exciting secret!
entries.ru: А в тканях секрет и того чудеснее!

entries.en:
(She really opened up the moment we started talking
about her "trinkets"...)
entries.ru:
(Стоило заговорить о её «безделушках» —
и она разговорилась...)

entries.en:
Since you're here,{E108:0008} why don't I give you lovely boys a
taste of my relaxation magic, hm?
entries.ru:
Раз уж вы здесь,{E108:0008} милые мальчики, — не показать ли
вам моё волшебное расслабление?

entries.en:
Oh, Baddy-Bumpkin!{E108:0018} Can you get it all out and set it
up for me!?
entries.ru:
Ой, Баддик-увалень!{E108:0018} Достань-ка всё и расставь
для меня!

entries.en: The name...{E108:0010} is Badd.
entries.ru: Фамилия...{E108:0010} Бадд.

entries.en:
...Is that a "no"?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Why are you being so selfish, Baddy-Bumpkin?
entries.ru:
...Это что, «нет»?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Ну что ты такой вредный, Баддик-увалень?

entries.en:
...You!{E108:0010}
Have you finished taking photos of this room yet?
entries.ru:
...Эй!{E108:0010}
Вы уже отсняли эту комнату?

entries.en: Yessir!{E108:0018} We have, sir!
entries.ru: Так точно!{E108:0018} Отсняли!

entries.en:
...Then help Ms. Scone here with something, will
you...?
entries.ru: ...Тогда помогите тут мисс Сдобиной, ладно...?

entries.en: Yessir!{E108:0018} Right away, sir!
entries.ru: Так точно!{E108:0018} Сию минуту!

entries.en:
Teeheeheehee!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Oh, you're a sweetie at heart,{E108:0010} aren't you Baddy B!
entries.ru:
Ти-хи-хи-хи!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}А в душе ты добряк,{E108:0010} правда, Баддюша?

entries.en:
That's amazing, Ms. Scone...!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}You got him to do exactly
what you wanted!{E108:0018} That's some talent!
entries.ru:
Поразительно, мисс Сдобина...!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Он сделал ровно то,
что вы хотели!{E108:0018} Вот это дар!

entries.en:
Thank you ever so much, Baddykins!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}And you,{E108:0008} Officer Lovely!
entries.ru:
Спасибо тебе огромное, Баддюсенька!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}И тебе,{E108:0008} офицер Милашка!

entries.en:
She's even giving nicknames to the forensics guys
now...
entries.ru: Она уже и криминалистам клички раздаёт...

entries.en: I guess it's her way of showing that she cares.
entries.ru: Видимо, так она показывает участие.

entries.en:
So...{E108:0010} what about this is supposed to be...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}relaxing,
exactly...?
entries.ru:
Так...{E108:0010} и что тут должно быть...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}таким уж
расслабляющим...?

entries.en:
Oh, don't be a big sourpuss, Baddy B!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}The fun's only just beginning!
entries.ru:
Ну не будь брюзгой, Баддюша!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Всё веселье только начинается!

entries.en: Officer Lovely!{E108:0018} You can switch it on now!
entries.ru: Офицер Милашка!{E108:0018} Теперь включай!

entries.en: Yes, ma'am!
entries.ru: Так точно, мэм!

entries.en: Huh...
entries.ru: Хм...

entries.en: Wooow!{E108:0018} It's beautiful!
entries.ru: Ух ты-ы!{E108:0018} Красота!

entries.en:
It is...{E108:0018}
(I wish my son were here to see it.)
entries.ru:
И правда...{E108:0018}
(Жаль, сын этого не видит.)

entries.en: Isn't it, though?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Isn't it just wonderful?
entries.ru: Ведь правда?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Ну разве не чудо?

entries.en:
"{E041}The Four Adorable Elves and the Sweetest Little
Castle Made of Sweets{E040}".{E108:0010} That's my theme, you see.
entries.ru:
«{E041}Четыре милых эльфа и сладчайший замок
из сладостей{E040}».{E108:0010} Вот моя тема.

entries.en:
And I thought it would be extra lovely if it was all lit
up!{E108:0010} Isn't it the nicest thing you've ever seen?
entries.ru:
И я подумала: с подсветкой выйдет ещё прелестнее!{E108:0010}
Ну разве вы видели что-то милее?

entries.en: (One of the elves must be feeling a little left out...)
entries.ru: (Один эльф, похоже, остался обделён...)

entries.en: This is how it was supposed to look for the contest...
entries.ru: Вот так всё и должно было выглядеть на конкурсе...

entries.en: But I'm glad you lovely boys got to see it, at least!
entries.ru:
Но я рада, что хоть вы, милые мальчики,
это увидели!

entries.en: Wait...{E108:0018} Shouldn't the lamps be lit up, too?
entries.ru: Погодите...{E108:0018} А лампы разве не должны гореть?

entries.en:
O-Oh...{E108:0010} I...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}What's happened there, I wonder?
entries.ru:
О-Ой...{E108:0010} Я...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}И что же там такое стряслось?

entries.en:
(I think we'd better take a look at the lamps and the
elves one more time...)
entries.ru:
(Пожалуй, стоит ещё раз взглянуть на лампы
и на эльфов...)

entries.en:
We know that the victim was struck and killed with
something blunt.

And we found blood on one of the lamps,{E108:0008} which has a
smashed bulb inside.
Could the lamp not have been the murder weapon?

For sure!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It could definitely do enough damage to kill
someone!

...You,{E108:0008} science guy.{E108:0010} Did you finish analyzing the blood
from the lamp yet?
Yessir!{E108:0018} Just got done a minute ago, sir!
The blood is the victim's.{E108:0010} No doubt about it.
...There you have it.

Salt Lamp added to the Court Record.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E176:00030000}{E146:00050001}{E143}{E12A:0005}{E150:00050018}{E100:0000}{E101:00050005}{E107:0002}(So the murder weapon was hidden in Ms. Scone's
room...)

(I'm beginning to think we may need to add her to our
list of suspects.)

The whipped cream in this room is collapsing because
the temperature is too high.

It's 68 degrees...{E108:0010} My messed-up shoes can vouch for
that...
And yet...

When you opened the doors to the castle,{E108:0008} the handles
themselves were just fine.
Yeah...{E108:0010} They were sturdier than expected...

"Sturdy"...?{E108:0010} That's not the way I would describe most
things made of confectionaries.

I think we'd better take another look at those handles,{E108:0008}
don't you?
...What the...!?

I think it's safe to say {E172:00100000}those handles aren't made of
candy.

...It's not just the handles.{E108:0010} The whole castle,{E108:0008} the little
elves...

They're all just plastic models with whipped cream
smeared on top.
Whaaat!?{E108:0020} {E12F:001E0007}{E107:0002}So none of this is confectionery art after all?

No.{E108:0010} It's simply {E043}made to look like candy{E040},{E108:0008} with the cream
having been added to lend it all an air of authenticity.

So not only did she use decorations that were against
the rules,{E108:0008} she didn't even make any real sweets...
Ms. Scone made a mockery of the rules.

Yeah...{E108:0010} Guess she's not gonna get crowned "World's
Greatest" now...

And why's it so warm in here?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Do you think it's got something to do with all this?

Fake Confections added
to the Court Record.{E106}{E1CF}{E12F:00050006}{E100:0000}{E101:00050005}{E107:0002}That's a good question.
I think we'd better go ask Ms. Scone herself.

Ms. Scone appears to lack basic knowledge about how
confectionery is created.

And she says that she snuck into another entrant's
room for "research" purposes...

Hardly the actions of a world-class confectioner
competing for a major prize.

Yeah...{E108:0008} Not how I'd picture a top pro acting.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Does she maybe just lack a little confidence, or...?
(Or is she not actually a confectioner at all...?)
Perhaps she had another agenda altogether.

...After all,{E108:0008} we only have her word for it that she went
into that room to do some "research".
Wait,{E108:0008} you mean...
Maybe she went in there to commit a murder?
There's no way of saying so for certain just yet.

(But she is hiding something,{E108:0008} that much I'm certain
of...)

(Mr. Frost's blood went missing from the crime
scene...)
(But traces of it showed up in the fountain.)

(Why go to the trouble of removing the blood from the
scene after the body had been discovered?)
(And why only the blood?)
(Surely the body would've also been in the way?)

(Wait...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}Could someone have {E043}moved the body aside{E042} to
get to the blood?)

(So the body might have been moved aside...{E108:0018} Or even
removed from the scene of the crime entirely...)

(After all,{E108:0008} as far as we know,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}there's still no autopsy
report.)

(We've learned plenty about the murder weapon and
the suspect,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but very little about the body itself.)

(Our assumption thus far has been that {E041}the body had
been recovered by the forensics team{E042}...)
(But what if that {E041}assumption{E042} is false...!?)

(What if Mr. von Karma wouldn't show Detective Badd
the autopsy report out of something other than spite?)

(What if we've been thinking about this{E108:0008} {E285}{E12F:00050006}{E041}the wrong way
around{E042} {E172:003C0001}all along!?)

(The question isn't{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E041}why did Mr. von Karma hold back
information about the body?{E042})

(It's{E108:0008} {E1D5}{E041}did Mr. von Karma even have any information
about the body in the first place?{E042})
(...How do things look from that angle?)

(Perhaps the body hadn't been removed by the police
in order to carry out an autopsy.)

(Perhaps it had already been removed and hidden
away by the culprit before their arrival!)

...We've both heard {E1D5}the rumors about Mr. von Karma's
questionable methods.

Fabricated witness statements,{E108:0008} shady deals...{E108:0010} forged
evidence, even.

Sure.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Everybody's heard of that stuff.{E108:001E}
{E107:0002}{E12F:001E0007}But...{E108:0010} {E1D1}what's that got to do with us right now?

I would never judge a person on the basis of rumors
alone.

Even Mr. von Karma.{E108:0010} I've tried my best not to let my
preconceptions color our interactions with him.

Nonetheless...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}it appears he may indeed be willing {E1D5}{E1D1}to
twist the truth to his own ends.

T-Twist the truth?{E108:001E}
You mean...{E108:0010} {E12F:001E0001}{E280}{E107:0001}he's been playing dirty!?
...I fear he might have been,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}and still is.
(And I'm not about to let him get away with it!)

I suspect the difference in aroma we noticed is due to
the teapots having been switched.
You do?
entries.ru: Есть?

entries.en:
I can't see what else it could have been.{E108:0010}
The tea itself hadn't changed.
...Why don't we ask Ms. Bound,{E108:0008} just to be sure?
Ms. Bound.

The difference in aroma we noticed --{E108:0008} do you think it
could have been because of the different teapot?

My cup just now had a subtle minty scent.{E108:0010}
Rather like Uva tea...

Oh!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I just remembered!{E108:0010} I made some peppermint tea
in that pot only yesterday.

The tea from the teapot Larry switched in from under
the cart smelled faintly of mint.

Right.{E108:0010} Ms. Bound said she used that pot to make
peppermint tea yesterday.

Yes...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But there's something else that's been troubling
me.

Ms. Bound seemed more taken aback by the switching
of the teapots than the breaking of one.

...You're right!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}You'd expect it to be the other way
around!

I suspect she might have been deliberately hiding the
teapot underneath the cart.
But why...?
entries.ru: Но зачем...?

entries.en:
One of Ubiquium's key characteristics is its {E041}minty
fragrance{E040}.
So what if she had been hiding some in that teapot?

Whaaaaaat!?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}In the teapot!?

haven't found anything yet.

came from!
...I may have an idea.

useless--{E108:0020} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00090002}What?
You DO know where it came from!?
Yes.

entries.en: ...Ms. Bound's teapot.
Wow!{E108:0018} Nice piece!{E108:0010} {E1D1}I like it!

...Yeah,{E108:0008} this looks like a fitting prize for a

It's not a prize!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It's a vital piece of evidence!

Oh,{E108:0008} it's just evidence?{E108:0010} Then I'll have one of the
forensics people check it out.
Mr. Edgeworth...
Is there some sort of problem with my teapot?

Possibly.{E108:0010} The minty fragrance we noticed coming from
it...

...I think it just might be the scent of one of the
chemicals used to make the poison gas.
But,{E108:0008} {E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth...
Surely you don't think I had anything to do with that?

The method used to create the gas would have
required considerable preparation.

Nobody would have had the time or the opportunity to
set that up{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E1D1}except you.
...That's not strictly true.

It took around a week to get Zodiac Hall ready for the
exhibition.

There were all kinds of people coming and going
through here during that time.{E108:0010} Delicia, for one.

So you see,{E108:0008} I'm not the only person who could have set
it up at all.

Ms. Scone is on our radar too, of course.{E108:0010}
You needn't worry about that.

And besides...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:001C0004}I wouldn't know the first thing about
making poison gas.
So even if you did find some Ubiquium in my teapot...
...I wouldn't have had any idea what to do with it.

But I suppose we should see what the test results say
first.

(Ms. Bound claims she {E041}doesn't know the first thing
about making poison gas{E042}.)
(I need to find a way to prove that she's lying...)

The ultimate cookbook contained instructions on how
to create the poison gas.

And the current owner of that book is none other than
Ms. Judy Bound...

I'm afraid I do.{E108:0010} Ms. Bound would have been perfectly
capable of setting up the gas trap.
Finally...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1DA}we can prove that she's been lying to us!

Photographing the cookbook's contents would be the
perfect way to steal its secrets undetected.

Mr. Tangaroa's camera to photograph the book?

it and getting chased by the cops!

A sneaky snapshot or twenty, huh?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}That could work...
The only question is,{E108:0008} when would he have done it?

Good question...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}What about {E1D1}during afternoon tea?

Didn't Delicia say that Gusto and Frost had {E043}missed out

know for certain that Mr. Frost was still alive...?)

После полдника{E108:0008} я на цыпочках заглянула

entries.en:
(Mr. Frost had kept to himself inside his room after the
contest had started.)

(But he was gone by the time Ms. Scone snuck into it
to sample his work.)

(Meaning there's a good chance he was murdered
{E1D2}before the end of afternoon tea.)
...Mr. Gusto.

You and Mr. Frost conspired to create works for the
contest together, did you not?
Huh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}So you know my little secret.
Mr. Fender was kind enough to inform me.

Mr. Frost was in charge of the designs,{E108:0008} while you were
in charge of the flavor.{E108:0010} Is that correct?

Hngh...{E108:0010} What can I say?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I still had a long way to travel
on the road to becoming a master confectioner.

But you only collaborated up through the semifinal.{E108:0010}
Something changed after that.

We both wanted to show what we could do.{E108:0010}
Show that we were better than Tangaroa.

Then why did you help Mr. Frost with his entry for
the final!?
Nrngh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}What grounds do you have to say that?

Your own statement,{E108:0010} made to Mr. von Karma eighteen
years ago.

You told him that you had been working together right
up until the day before the final.

Mr. Frost's entry was {E1D1}carved entirely from blocks of
{E041}flavored ice{E040}.

Работа мистера Морозова {E1D1}вырезана целиком из глыб
{E041}фруктового льда{E040}.

Льда, которому нужны {E188:00300000}{E1D5}как минимум
{E041}сутки на заморозку{E040}.

And whose flavors would therefore {E283}have already been

А значит, вкус для него {E283}уже приготовил
заранее мистер Густо!

That he helped Frost until the day before the final.
entries.ru:
Да,{E108:0008} и это в точности сходится со словами Густо.{E108:0010}
Что он помогал Морозову до дня перед финалом.

entries.en:
In that case,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}why didn't Mr. Frost reciprocate and help
Mr. Gusto in return?
entries.ru:
В таком случае{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}почему мистер Морозов не ответил
тем же и не помог мистеру Густо?

entries.en:
...I can hardly be expected to read the minds of the
dead.
entries.ru: ...Читать мысли мертвецов я, увы, не умею.

entries.en: So,{E108:0008} why didn't Mr. Frost help you in return,{E108:0010} hm?
Hngh......

I submit that your relationship broke down for some
reason...

...and that that became the basis of your motive for
murder!

Hrrrrrrrnnnghhhhh...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's not how it was!

Sure!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}We stopped working together.{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}But it was all perfectly friendly!

You stopped working together...{E108:0008} in a friendly way?{E108:0018}
Kinda hard to imagine, but okay...

Besides,{E108:0010} how do you think I did it, exactly?{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}You think
I just strolled into Tangaroa's room and killed Frost?

I {E043}couldn't have killed the man{E040} while Tangaroa was in
there working on his chocolate pieces, could I!?{E106}{E198:0002002D}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12D:00030888}{E100:0000}{E12F:00200000}{E112:0020}{E101:00200020}{E107:0002}So you see?{E108:0010} It can't have been me.
(...I wouldn't be so sure.)

(There must be a window of time when Mr. Tangaroa
wasn't in his room.)

(And if I can prove that,{E108:0008} I can prove that Mr. Gusto
had the opportunity to kill Mr. Frost!)

(We can be sure that Mr. Frost was alive until the
beginning of afternoon tea.)

(Making tea time the only window during which
Mr. Gusto could have killed him.)

Are you satisfied with Mr. Gusto's story now,
Mr. Edgeworth?
Heh...{E108:0010} Sadly, I'm afraid I'm still rather unsatisfied.

But things are finally starting to become clear.{E108:0010}
{E188:00200000}{E107:0001}And the truth will soon come to light at last!

Do you mean to say that you have uncovered new
evidence?

I was hoping I might convince Mr. Gusto to open up to
us about it instead.

Oh!{E108:0018}
Is it mind games time again!?

It is.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00000008}...Mr. Gusto,{E108:0008} I have a question for you.
I said,{E108:0010} I have a question for you!

Nrrrraaaggghhh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Wh-What is it!?

You chose to make your entry for the final on your
own.

I told you.{E108:0008} I wanted to test myself.{E108:0010}
I wanted to prove I was the best in the world.

If that were the case,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}then surely you wouldn't have
chosen to cheat in the first place.

So tell me, Mr. Gusto:{E108:0010} Why did you feel the need to
team up with Mr. Frost?
